meta.source: The Verge (theverge.com, 2022 redesign) as documented by third-party reconstructions; Jelly Mint replaced with cerulean, and a warm third accent (flare) added.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Near-black, not pure black, in dark; white for long-read article pages in light.

tokens.name: surface-slate
tokens.usage: Secondary cards and secondary buttons. Text on it: ink-on-slate.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a button. Brief; never a resting fill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 1px border that does the work shadows do elsewhere: story tiles, inputs, the nav underline. Full strength, on purpose.

tokens.name: hairline-soft
tokens.usage: 1px frame around images and quiet dividers inside a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas. Also the spotlight-tile fill (white tile in dark), with on-cerulean text on top.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Bylines, timestamps, credits, placeholders. 6.1:1 on canvas in dark, 5.3:1 in light; 4.5:1 on surface-slate in dark (at the floor: keep it to 12px+).

tokens.name: ink-on-slate
tokens.usage: Text on surface-slate.

tokens.name: cerulean
tokens.usage: THE accent — replaces The Verge's Jelly Mint (#3cffd0). Primary button fill, active borders, highlight tiles, pill tags. 7.0:1 against canvas in dark. As a fill in light it needs a hairline or ink text to hold its edge (2.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: on-cerulean
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a cerulean (or spotlight) fill: 7.9:1. Never white on cerulean.

tokens.name: cerulean-ink
tokens.usage: Cerulean as TEXT: links, outlined-button labels, the headline hover. 8.8:1 dark, 5.9:1 light.

tokens.name: cerulean-deep
tokens.usage: 1px outline around cerulean elements (3.5:1 on cerulean, the 3:1 non-text bar), and a deep fill that takes white text (9.6:1). Never text on cerulean. Replaces The Verge's Console Mint Border (#309875).

tokens.name: ultraviolet
tokens.usage: The second hazard accent. Alternate tiles, promo outlines, error. As a fill take on-ultraviolet text. As text on dark canvas it fails (2.5:1): use ultraviolet-ink.

tokens.name: on-ultraviolet
tokens.usage: Text on an ultraviolet fill: 7.5:1.

tokens.name: ultraviolet-ink
tokens.usage: Ultraviolet as text or a 1px outline: 6.8:1 on dark canvas, 7.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: The warm third accent — a signal-flare orange, the complement of cerulean. Reserved for LIVE and BREAKING: live-blog tags, the breaking banner, the one hot tile on a page. 7.2:1 against dark canvas. Same lightness as cerulean (1.1:1 between them), so the two vibrate where they touch: that clash is intended, but never let cerulean-vs-flare be the only cue for meaning — always label.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a flare fill: 8.1:1. Never white on flare.

tokens.name: flare-ink
tokens.usage: Flare as TEXT or a 1px outline: the LIVE label, live timestamps. 8.0:1 on dark canvas, 6.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: ultraviolet-rule
tokens.usage: The vertical timeline rail on feed items. Decorative only: 1.7:1 on dark canvas, kept from the source and flagged; never the only cue for anything.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus, 2px outline at 2px offset. The source used a cyan (#1eaedb) that would now sit right on top of cerulean, so focus moved to white (dark) and ultraviolet (light).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error borders and messages. The Verge spends ultraviolet on errors rather than adding a red.

tokens.name: overlay-ring
tokens.usage: 1px ring on stacked cards and over images.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The wordmark-scale headline. One per page. Source: Manuka 900 at 0.80; Anton needs the extra leading.

styles.name: button-mono
styles.usage: Every button label, UPPERCASE. The mono-caps move is the second most recognisable thing in this system after the display face.

styles.name: serif-body
styles.usage: Review decks and print-voice excerpts. Sparingly.

spacing.note: 8px base with half steps. Section padding 32–64; feed gaps 12–16; card padding 20–32 (feature 40–48); container 24 mobile, 48 desktop; max width ~1300.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tag vertical padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gutters inside feed items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between feed items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Column gutters, feed gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Compact card padding; outlined-button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button side padding, mobile container.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Story tile padding; section padding minimum.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Feature card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop container padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding maximum.

radius.note: Two worlds: near-square for media and inputs (2–4px), very round for tiles and buttons (20–40px). Nothing in between.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Inline images.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nested images, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Story tiles, color tiles, pill tags.

tokens.name: radius-feature
tokens.usage: Feature cards, primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-promo
tokens.usage: Large promo buttons, ultraviolet outlines.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Outlined cerulean CTA pills.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars, icon buttons.

shadow.note: No drop shadows, glows or gradients. Depth is color and 1px lines.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Stacked cards over imagery.
